newsitem.title: USA: Oregon Man kills himself after bombing restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Oregon Man kills himself after bombing restaurants.

text.p: An Oregon man with a history of menacing his neighbours bombed two restaurants and then killed himself, police said Monday.

Michael McClain, 42, of Astoria, shot himself in the head with a .38 calibre pistol after setting off an explosive device at the Pig'N Pancake restaurant during the height of the Sunday breakfast rush, police said.

McClain also was responsible for a timer bomb that went off five minutes earlier at the nearby Dutch Cup restaurant, Astoria police Capt. Alan Oja said. The bombs caused only slight damage and one minor injury but police later found 40 pounds of undetonated high-grade commercial explosives in the two restaurants that could have caused fatalities.

In 1979, his father took his own life in a courtroom after wounding his estranged wife and killing her attorney. McClain himself had been arrested several times for menacing, most recently in September when he allegedly aimed a handgun at a neighbour, police said.
The devices that went off were made from homemade explosives that are being analysed, Oja said. Police said they had no clues to McClain's motives but believe he acted alone.
